##### Project general facts

The Highgrove by Ellington Properties is a refined residential development located in Meydan, offering a curated selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside exclusive duplexes, penthouses, and sky villas. The architecture reflects a contemporary design language shaped by clean lines, soft natural influences, and expansive glazing that maximizes light and views. Overlooking both the Dubai skyline and a tranquil lagoon, the project creates a balanced environment where modern city living meets calm, nature-inspired surroundings, with a layout designed for privacy, openness, and visual connection to the landscape.

The lifestyle at The Highgrove is defined by a rich collection of resort-style amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and social living. A 60-meter infinity pool framed by landscaped greenery forms the centerpiece, complemented by a crystal lagoon and multiple outdoor relaxation zones. Residents benefit from a full wellness ecosystem including indoor and outdoor fitness studios, yoga spaces, a spa with flotation therapy, sauna, and treatment rooms. Leisure and entertainment offerings include a cinema room, media lounge, sky dining deck, clubhouse, library, co-working spaces, and dedicated children’s play areas, creating a complete environment for all generations.

Interiors at The Highgrove are finished with modern, high-quality materials that emphasize elegance, comfort, and natural harmony. Open-plan kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, combining functionality with a clean architectural aesthetic. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their living spaces, while refined finishes, soft textures, and thoughtful detailing ensure a sophisticated foundation for contemporary living.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
